resources.string: A calmer way to stay alert to digital fraud.
Analyzes notifications you allow, identifies suspicious incoming callers by reputation, and checks links, QR codes and screenshots you share.
You choose what to enable. Manual checks remain available when permissions are denied.
PHASE 1 · Screen preview. This feature is not connected yet.
DEMO · Synthetic examples. No real fraud verdicts or alerts are generated.

Version 1 warns about suspicious signals. It does not automatically block calls or payments.
Your checked messages, calls and links will appear here. A quiet history does not guarantee safety.

A risk score describes this check. It cannot guarantee safety.

Submit evidence for review, with only the information you choose to share.
Supported evidence is planned for screenshots, APK references, numbers and UPI IDs. Never submit full credentials.
Report submission and offline queue are planned for Phase 3. Nothing is submitted from this preview.
Spot suspicious wording in supported notifications and SMS you allow. Check shared links yourself.
The investigation service checks available signals and explains its findings in plain language.
Get clear next steps. Verify through official channels and ask for help before sending money.
On-device first. Nothing leaves your phone without consent. When you allow a cloud check, the selected content is sent to the investigation service.
PHASE 1 · Rationale preview. OS permission requests will be connected in Phase 2. No permission is requested now.
Analyze notification title and text that Android makes available and you allow. This does not read all WhatsApp messages.
Identify suspicious incoming callers by reputation. FraudShield does not listen to or record calls, and does not auto-block them.
Check newly received SMS after you grant permission and consent. Existing SMS history is not read. Availability depends on distribution policy.
Scan a QR code only when you open the scanner. You can paste a link instead.
Choose a family contact only after opting in. Your address book is never uploaded as a whole.
Skip for now · use manual mode
Camera scanning will be connected in Phase 3. Camera permission is only requested after its rationale.
The photo picker and upload consent will be connected in Phase 3. No gallery access is requested here.
This preview loads a fixed Demo example for the selected tab. It does not analyze the text you enter.
Live checks and consent will be connected in Phase 2. This screen does not send your input.
Check links, QR codes and screenshots you choose to share.
Ask for plain-language guidance about a suspicious interaction.
How do I freeze my account?
Understand your checking activity and the scam vectors reported by the service.
Weekly volume, categories and top scam vectors will be connected in Phase 3. No statistics are invented here.
Choose trusted family members to receive redacted warnings.
Member management and backend alerts are planned for Phase 3.
Family protection is opt-in. Obtain each person’s consent. Shared warnings exclude message text, OTPs and financial details.
You are not alone. Take one step at a time, and act promptly if money was lost.
Opens your dialer. You confirm the call.
No app could open this action. Dial 1930 manually or visit cybercrime.gov.in in your browser.

1. Open your official bank app, or use the phone number printed on your card.\n2. Tell the bank a transaction may be fraudulent and ask about restricting affected payment channels.\n3. Follow the bank’s verification process. Get a complaint reference.
Keep screenshots, message timestamps, sender details, UPI transaction references and only the last four digits of your account.
Never share your full account credentials, password, OTP or UPI PIN.

Do not send money in response to threats or extortion. Keep evidence. Contact 1930 or local police. Report suspicious financial services through RBI Sachet. Verify any legitimate repayment obligation with the regulated lender.
PHASE 1 · Privacy controls and data operations will be connected in Phase 3.
Data counts, export, deletion and correction requests are planned. No deletion or export is simulated.
FOR-LEGAL-REVIEW · Privacy and DPDP notices are draft copy.
Checks use backend findings about supported signals. Reputation can be incomplete or outdated. A verdict is not a guarantee; verify requests using official channels.
FraudShield provides informational guidance, not legal or financial advice. No analytics SDK is included.
Cloud checks are awaiting backend configuration. Saved checks and emergency help remain available.
Bank app unavailable? Open your official bank app yourself, or use the number printed on your card.
Blocking is manual in version 1. Open your SMS or Phone app, select this sender or number, and use its block option. FraudShield does not change your block list.
Ask for a correction if this result seems wrong. Your feedback does not change the original verdict until the service reviews it.
DEMO uses fixed synthetic results. The text you enter is not investigated and does not leave the device.
I understand this is a Demo example
Checks only the supported sources you enabled. Verify requests using official channels.
Correction submission is awaiting the backend feedback contract.
Choose an installed bank app. Ask your bank to restrict affected payment channels and get a complaint reference. FraudShield cannot freeze an account for you.
Only this selected content will be sent to the investigation service when you press Check. OTP digits near an OTP label are redacted on-device. Do not include credentials.
I agree to send this content for this check

Allow relevant text from selected notifications and newly received SMS, plus incoming caller numbers, to be sent for cloud checks. Each source stays off until you enable it. You can pause or withdraw consent in Settings.
